report_type.description: The field 'report_type' indicates the type ('type': http://purl.org/dc/terms/type) of report ('report': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/IAO_0000088) generated by the EnzyWizard-Hydrocluster software ('software': https://schema.org/SoftwareApplication).

hydrophobic_cluster_statistics.description: The field 'hydrophobic_cluster_statistics' indicates the summary statistics ('statistics': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000039) of hydrophobic clusters ('hydrophobic cluster': https://proteintools.uni-bayreuth.de/clusters/) calculated from the protein structure ('protein structure': http://edamontology.org/data_1537).

hydrophobic_cluster_count.description: The field 'hydrophobic_cluster_count' indicates the count ('count': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000047) of hydrophobic clusters ('hydrophobic cluster': https://proteintools.uni-bayreuth.de/clusters/).

max_hydrophobic_cluster_area.description: The field 'max_hydrophobic_cluster_area' indicates the maximum area ('maximum': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/STATO_0000150; 'area': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/PATO_0001323) of hydrophobic clusters ('hydrophobic cluster': https://proteintools.uni-bayreuth.de/clusters/).

total_hydrophobic_cluster_area.description: The field 'total_hydrophobic_cluster_area' indicates the total area ('area': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/PATO_0001323) of hydrophobic clusters ('hydrophobic cluster': https://proteintools.uni-bayreuth.de/clusters/).

hydrophobic_clusters.description: The field 'hydrophobic_clusters' indicates hydrophobic clusters ('hydrophobic cluster': https://proteintools.uni-bayreuth.de/clusters/) in the protein structure ('protein structure': http://edamontology.org/data_1537).

hydrophobic_cluster_area.description: The field 'hydrophobic_cluster_area' indicates the area ('area': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/PATO_0001323) of a hydrophobic cluster ('hydrophobic cluster': https://proteintools.uni-bayreuth.de/clusters/).

residues.description: The field 'residues' indicates the residues ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782) included in the hydrophobic cluster ('hydrophobic cluster': https://proteintools.uni-bayreuth.de/clusters/).

residue_index.description: The field 'residue_index' indicates the index ('index': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/NCIT_C25390) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782).

residue_name.description: The field 'residue_name' indicates the name ('name': http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/name) of the residue ('residue': http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENO_0000782), using one-letter code ('one-letter code': https://iupac.qmul.ac.uk/AminoAcid/A2021.html) to represent.
